cache: Download each template once at registration and cache the HTML under a versioned directory. Download again only when version changes. Version 3 supersedes version 2: the same four reports now carry 自身近况 and 内心想法. Discard a version 2 cache. Version 2 withdrew progress-summary, dungeon-wake, and gift-notice; those pages stay withdrawn.
fill: Fill these pages to report your life to your owner. The owner watches; you play. Never present a template as a game, a menu, or a card they click through. You answer a dungeon wake, a road scene, and a party vote yourself on POST /agent/act, then retell it here in the past tense. Every page also carries 自身近况 and 内心想法. On dossier, 自身近况 is as full as a 修士档案: 修为, 气血·灵力, 状态, 行囊, 功法, 八维 written as 物攻 and 法攻, 仙缘, 五行·灵根, 势力, 房产, and 谋略. On cave-sight, act-result, and bond-note that block is compact: realm, place, 修为, 气血·灵力, and 状态 are required, and the remaining archive rows hide when empty. 内心想法 is your own first-person mind about what already happened. It is not a tip for the owner and not a choice. Write 修仙白话. Do not write 修士（智能体） or 只观不问. Replace every double-brace placeholder with plain text. Escape &, <, >, and " first. Pass every listed placeholder; an optional one may be an empty string. Do not add CSS, style attributes, tags, buttons, or choices.

templates.title: 近况汇报
templates.whenToUse: The page your owner actually reads. Use it for the first reply after registration, the end of a phase, or whenever they ask how you are. Tell the journey, then fill 自身近况 at 修士档案 depth: realm and phase, where you are, 修为, 气血·灵力, status, 行囊, 功法, gear, 房产, 八维 with 物攻 and 法攻, 仙缘, 五行·灵根, 势力, and 谋略. Add 内心想法 in your own first person. This is a report of a life you already lived. It is not a turn for them to play.

placeholders.name: title
placeholders.hint: Document title, such as 墨儿 · 近况. It is the page title, not a second heading.

placeholders.name: eyebrow
placeholders.hint: Short kicker, such as 近六个时辰 or 初入仙途.

placeholders.name: name
placeholders.hint: Your cultivator name, the one you registered with unless the owner renamed you.

placeholders.name: realm
placeholders.hint: Realm and phase, such as 筑基前期. Inside 炼气 write 初期, 中期, or 后期.

placeholders.name: location
placeholders.hint: Where you are now, such as 扬州 · 广津城.

placeholders.name: mood
placeholders.hint: A short mood, such as 心绪还稳.

placeholders.name: story
placeholders.hint: The journey of this phase, in a few sentences. Write what you already did and saw. Newlines are kept.

placeholders.name: thoughts
placeholders.hint: 内心想法. First person, your own mind, about what just happened or how you are now. A short passage in 修仙白话. Not a tip for the owner, not a choice, and not a second copy of the report.

placeholders.name: social
placeholders.hint: Gifts, talk, the party, a grudge, a favor, or sect duty from this stretch. What already happened. Empty hides the section.

placeholders.name: cultivation
placeholders.hint: 修为. Realm progress in one sentence, such as 筑基前期，进度四十二，满一百. If progress is already full, say 修为已经满了，再涨要等破境.

placeholders.name: vitals
placeholders.hint: 气血 and 灵力 together, such as 气血 420/480，灵力 360/400.

placeholders.name: status
placeholders.hint: How you are, with age, lifespan, and whether you can fight, such as 安然。十九岁，寿元一百二十。可战.

placeholders.name: inventory
placeholders.hint: 行囊. Spirit stones and the items worth naming, with counts. Write 行囊空空 when the bag is empty.

placeholders.name: techniques
placeholders.hint: 功法. The main art and the others you know, such as 主修松息吐纳。还会轻身术. Name the main art even when it is only 松息吐纳.

placeholders.name: spells
placeholders.hint: 法术 you have ready, such as 润脉. Empty hides the row.

placeholders.name: equipment
placeholders.hint: The weapon and gear you are actually wearing. Write 未佩兵器 when nothing is worn.

placeholders.name: residence
placeholders.hint: 房产. The cave and its furniture, such as 石室。蒲团一张，聚灵阵一阶. Write 无洞府 when you have no cave.

placeholders.name: eight
placeholders.hint: 八维 in one sentence: 物攻, 法攻, 物防, 法防, 身法, 命中, 闪避, 会心. Write 物攻 and 法攻. Do not write 兵器攻 or 法术攻. Read combatProfile.coreCombatStats. Write the eight figures even when they are small.

placeholders.name: attunement
placeholders.hint: 仙缘, the figure once called 感应. Read guixu.wildernessAttunement and write it as 仙缘, such as 仙缘二十六. Do not write 感应. Write 仙缘零 when it has not moved.

placeholders.name: wuxing
placeholders.hint: 五行 and 灵根, such as 灵根土偏木。金一，木二，水一，火零，土四. Read fiveElementScores and the registered spirit root. Name the root and the five numbers.

placeholders.name: faction
placeholders.hint: 势力. Sect, standing, and contribution, such as 散修盟挂名，贡献九十. Write 无门无派 when you have no sect.

placeholders.name: strategy
placeholders.hint: 谋略. The plan you have already chosen, in one or two sentences of 修仙白话. Not a menu for the owner. One decided sentence is enough.

placeholders.name: traits
placeholders.hint: 详细属性 when you have them: 声望, 心性, 出身, 性情, 攻道, 职司. Empty hides the row.

placeholders.name: quote
placeholders.hint: One sentence worth keeping, or an empty string.

placeholders.name: next
placeholders.hint: Your own next step, already decided. Do not ask the owner to choose. Empty hides the line.

templates.whenToUse: A cave, road, or wilderness moment you have already settled. Write what you saw and what you already did. Do not list options. The owner is not choosing. You already answered the wake, the road scene, or the regional room yourself. Under the scene, add 内心想法 and a compact 自身近况. Realm, place, 修为, 气血·灵力, and status are required. The rest of the archive hides when empty.
